forms.label: Salt-pickled, traditional, pitted
forms.sourceDataset: Japanese Standard Tables of Food Composition in Japan, 2015 (Seventh Revised Edition), item 07022
forms.sourceNote: The Japanese table's entry for traditional salt-pickled umeboshi, pitted, as reproduced in the Wikipedia article on umeboshi. The table gives energy in kilojoules only; the kilocalorie figure here is that value divided by 4.184. The reduced-salt umeboshi is a separate entry and is not used.
